notes: AzCrash edge NPZ from Edge V1-V3, rows at velocities 0.42, 0.628 and 1.0, set so each row renders at its recording's level relative to the loudest (-13 and -6 dB). Envelopes by the onset specification (ONSET_SPECIFICATION.md): per 20 ms frame, the sum of the SPEAR partial amplitudes in each of the plugin's 22 bands, each partial by its mean frequency; a 60 ms Gaussian over the whole envelope; normalised by the global peak. Each band's level then matched to its recording (CrashSoft, CrashMedium, CrashLoud) by one constant gain per band and row, found by rendering (windows 0-0.2, 0.3-1.5 and 1.5-4 s, weighted 0.4, 0.4, 0.2), so the envelope keeps its measured shape. From 2.5 s each band decays at its recording's measured band decay, out to 30 s: SPEAR loses the quiet tail. velw per row: each band's norm from the +-5 Hz SPEAR range search (PRESET_IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md step 5), the weights within the band from the row's recording (the energy within +-0.12 %, at least 1.5 Hz, of each mode, 0.05-1.0 s after the strike). Shared peaks: every row's velw is 1.0 at mode 482 (3963.5 Hz) and its envelope 1.0 at frame 8, band 16, so a blend of two rows keeps its level (the engine normalises a blend by its peak).
